title: The Missing Sapphire
description: 消失的蓝宝石 · 可玩案件切片

steps.title: 01 · 接受案件
steps.en: Emma: The sapphire vanished after the inaugural exhibition. The display was opened at 9:10 p.m. We must establish who had access.
steps.zh: Emma：蓝宝石在开幕展览后失踪。展柜于晚上9点10分被打开。我们必须查清谁有权限进入。
steps.speaker: emma

steps.title: 案件词汇 · inaugural
steps.en: Read the exhibition notice before entering the gallery.
steps.zh: 进入展厅前，请阅读展览公告。

steps.title: 02 · 勘查博物馆
steps.en: The access log records: 21:10, cabinet opened with manager key M1. Only Robert holds M1. No duplicate key was issued; the lock is intact.
steps.zh: 门禁记录显示：21:10，展柜被经理钥匙M1打开。只有Robert持有M1，未配发备用钥匙，锁具完好。
steps.speaker: emma

steps.title: 03 · 询问保安
steps.en: David: I stayed at the north entrance from 9:00 to 9:20. Robert says he was in his office throughout that period.
steps.zh: David：9点到9点20分我一直在北门。Robert说他在这段时间始终待在办公室。
steps.speaker: david

steps.title: 04 · 分析监控
steps.en: Emma: Two cameras recorded simultaneously. The north camera shows David at his post at 9:10. The gallery camera shows Robert beside the cabinet at exactly the same time.
steps.zh: Emma：两台摄像机同步录像。北门摄像机显示David在9点10分仍在岗。展厅摄像机显示Robert恰在同一时间站在展柜旁。
steps.speaker: emma

options.text: Robert was beside the cabinet. / Robert在展柜旁。
David entered the gallery. / David进入展厅。
The office was empty all evening. / 办公室整晚无人。
Both cameras stopped. / 两台摄像机都停止了。

steps.title: 05 · 访问证人
steps.en: Sophia: At 9:12 I saw Robert leave the gallery with a blue pouch. I gave my time-stamped photograph to Emma. It shows his face and the pouch clearly.
steps.zh: Sophia：9点12分，我看到Robert带着一个蓝色小袋离开展厅。我把带时间戳的照片交给了Emma，照片清楚拍到了他的脸和小袋。
steps.speaker: sophia

steps.title: 06 · 分析物证
steps.en: Dr. Miller: The stone left in the display is glass. Its density is wrong for sapphire. It is a counterfeit. What does counterfeit mean here?
steps.zh: Miller博士：展柜里留下的石头是玻璃，它的密度与蓝宝石不符。它是一件赝品。这里counterfeit是什么意思？
steps.speaker: miller

steps.title: 07 · 整理矛盾证据
steps.en: The camera and access log contradict Robert’s office alibi. Two cameras recorded at the same time: they recorded ____.
steps.zh: 监控和门禁记录与Robert的办公室不在场说法矛盾。两台摄像机在同一时间录像：它们____录像。
steps.hint: 寻找表示“同时地”的副词。

steps.title: 08 · 嫌疑人对质
steps.en: Select the two records that place Robert at the cabinet at exactly 9:10, disproving his office alibi.
steps.zh: 选择两份能够证明Robert在9点10分身处展柜旁、从而推翻其办公室不在场说法的记录。
steps.speaker: alex

steps.title: 09 · 最终审讯
steps.en: Select the two independent records that directly disprove Robert’s claim that he stayed in his office.
steps.zh: 选择两份能够直接推翻Robert“始终在办公室”说法的独立记录。

options.text: Cabinet access log / 展柜门禁记录
Glass density report / 玻璃密度报告

steps.hint: 比较21:10的钥匙记录和两台摄像机的同步画面。

steps.title: 追回蓝宝石
steps.en: Robert: I replaced the sapphire with glass to sell it later. The blue pouch is in my office safe. Emma retrieves it with Robert present; Dr. Miller confirms the recovered stone is the missing sapphire.
steps.zh: Robert：我用玻璃替换蓝宝石，打算以后卖掉。蓝色小袋在我的办公室保险箱里。Emma在Robert在场时取出小袋；Miller博士确认找回的宝石就是失踪的蓝宝石。
steps.speaker: robert

steps.title: 10 · 结案报告
steps.en: The sapphire is recovered. The key log and synchronized video establish Robert’s access and expose his false alibi. The photograph corroborates his departure. David is cleared by the north camera.
steps.zh: 蓝宝石已追回。钥匙记录与同步录像证实Robert进入展柜并揭穿其虚假不在场证明。照片佐证了他的离开，北门录像则洗清了David的嫌疑。
